chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us, from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: "Repent to Allah a sincere repentance"
He said: It is the fasting of the day of Wednesday, the day of Thursday, and the day of Friday.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific meaning of sincere repentance according to Imam al-Sadiq in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the concept of *Tawbat al-Nusuh* by linking it to the specific practice of fasting on Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays, thereby grounding abstract spiritual repentance in tangible ritual observance. This interpretation highlights the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between consistent devotional acts and the purification of the soul, reflecting the broader theological view that sincere repentance requires both verbal acknowledgment and physical discipline.
